info.name: Sumo Logic Log Searches Estimated Usage API
info.description:
# Getting Started
Welcome to the Sumo Logic API reference.

request.description: Gets the estimated volume of data that would be scanned for a given log search in the Infrequent data tier.

response.name: Log search information along with its estimated usage details.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: basic

Added as a part of security scheme: basic

item.name: Gets Estimated Usage Details Per Metering Type

request.description: Gets the estimated volume of data, per metering type, that would be scanned for running a given log search for a given timerange.

response.name: Log search information along with its metering type wise estimated usage details.
